webmSubset.framing: Parse EBML IDs/sizes with checked VINT widths and parent-end containment, including arbitrary short reads. Require EBML header with WebM document type and supported read versions, then Segment, Info and one Tracks before media. Finite sizes are checked; unknown size is allowed only for Segment and Cluster. Recognize a new EBML initialization only at a structurally permitted sibling/top-level boundary, never by searching payload bytes. Unknown-size Cluster closes at a valid next Cluster/init boundary; a complete EOF may terminate it only with no incomplete finite child/block and an explicit complete-last-item fact.
webmSubset.initialization: Exactly one video TrackEntry with CodecID V_VP9, positive track number, width/height and integer TimestampScale. Permit the observed DefaultDuration, TrackTimestampScale absent/default1, CodecDelay absent/0; non1 scale or nonzero delay is unsupported, not silently ignored. Read bounded known color/display/codec-private fields as opaque-plus-parsed configuration evidence. Reject ContentEncodings, compression/encryption, external/previous/next segment linkage, codec-state changes and attachments or unknown elements with potential external/decoder semantics. Only explicitly listed harmless bounded metadata may be skipped; ignored bytes remain covered by the init hash.
webmSubset.blocks: Index unlaced SimpleBlock and one-Block BlockGroup forms for the admitted track. Validate signed relative timecode, flags/reserved bits, exact body extent and parent closure. Read bounded BlockDuration and signed ReferenceBlock values; cap references and reject duplicate/conflicting mandatory fields, unsupported BlockAdditions/DiscardPadding/CodecState and lacing. Stream or skip only the exact encoded payload extent. Container RAP is a candidate, not an independent-decoding certificate.
webmSubset.timing: Use checked Cluster timestamp plus signed block offset in TimestampScale units. BlockDuration, when present, is in TimestampScale ticks; otherwise an explicit DefaultDuration in nanoseconds is a separate exact rational basis. Never infer cadence from observed30fps or add rounded33ms repeatedly. Preserve zero-duration/unknown-duration as unsupported clock evidence when an end cannot be proved. Container timestamps must follow the admitted ordering; malformed/reset/overflow is not corrected with arrival time.
webmSubset.codecBoundary: Do not implement VP9 entropy decoding, full reference-picture state or a new mux. The initial index may check a bounded uncompressed key-header/profile/dimension prefix and superframe-index envelope to detect contradictions, but absence of a contradiction is not stable-codec/dependency proof. The fixed packet probe and full decoder remain necessary later. Observed invisible/altref superframes are not rejected merely because they contain multiple coded frames, nor treated as multiple presentation packets by guesswork.
webmSubset.scopeHonesty: This is a deliberately smaller supported subset than all valid WebM/MSE. A legal unimplemented element is Unsupported with its fixed category, not necessarily corrupt. An actually encountered structure outside the subset requires an evidence-backed contract amendment, not a parser fallback or payload scan.

aacMp4Subset.framing: Require each independently initialized unit to begin at structurally parsed ftyp followed by one moov and one or more complete moof/mdat media fragments. Support checked32-bit and64-bit declared box lengths; reject size0 extending-to-EOF in this first subset because repeated-init boundaries would be ambiguous. Every scalar read is bounded by that box's own end, not just the file buffer. Repeated ftyp is recognized only after a completed fragment, and is excluded from the preceding unit.
aacMp4Subset.initialization: Exactly one clear audio trak, one stsd mp4a sample entry, consistent tkhd/mdhd track identity and AAC-LC configuration, empty nonfragment sample tables and one matching mvex/trex. Inspect FullBox versions/flags and exact mandatory field lengths. Require data_reference_index1 and a single self-contained dref url entry with no external URL/URN payload. Reject encrypted sample entries/sinf/senc/saiz/saio/pssh, external references, edit lists, unsupported sample groups or unknown boxes that may alter sample interpretation. Explicitly harmless free/metadata boxes may be bounded/skipped and stay init-hash covered.
aacMp4Subset.aacConfiguration: Parse the bounded esds descriptor nesting and actual AAC AudioSpecificConfig without rewriting source bytes. Accept the already observed AAC-LC two-byte configuration and the existing proven16-byte form consisting of the same two bytes plus14 zero padding bytes; retain the exact full descriptor/init hash and a parsed semantic fingerprint. This reader does not call youtube_aac::normalize or assume every passed-through variant is valid. Reject HE-AAC/SBR/PS, explicit extension/PCE or unsupported rate/layout rather than mislabel them LC. Initially admitted parsed rates/layout must include the real44100Hz stereo fixture; other variants need explicit tests before acceptance.
aacMp4Subset.fragments: Require one matching traf with unique tfhd/tfdt and bounded trun entries, validated sequence/track/sample-description binding and movie-fragment-relative addressing. Support only explicit checked data-offset mapping with no base-data-offset external/implicit ambiguity. Sample sizes and durations resolve through the exact trun/tfhd/trex precedence; zero/missing/overflow values fail. AAC composition offsets must be absent or zero in this subset. Prove every sample range lies in the associated complete mdat, ordered/nonoverlapping with no unexplained bytes or sample-table residue. Multiple runs may be streamed if bounded metadata fully describes them; no arbitrary backward seek into another unit.
aacMp4Subset.timing: Keep tfdt as integer decode ticks and add each validated sample duration with checked arithmetic; AAC composition equals decode time in this subset. Check exact contiguous clock relation across fragments inside a unit. Cross-unit gap, overlap or reset is reported explicitly, not normalized. Never use append/generation order as the timestamp origin.
aacMp4Subset.unsupportedVersusMalformed: Legal but unimplemented edit-list/addressing/codec structures return Unsupported. Invalid lengths, conflicting IDs, external/protected references, out-of-range sample extents or contradictory mandatory structure return fixed unsafe/malformed classifications. None is downgraded to an incomplete final tail or delegated to permissive FFmpeg autodetection.

outcomesAndBounds.complete: CompleteIndex means every byte inside the accepted committed extent belongs to recognized complete structure and all unit records are structurally consistent. outcomesAndBounds.partialTail: Only insufficient bytes at the exact committed EOF while reading a known next header/finite field/body may produce PartialTail. Report its exact start/end, pending structural state and the last previously completed unit. Never resynchronize past it or promote the incomplete unit. A complete unknown-size Segment/Cluster at EOF is distinguished from a truncated Block/body; its physical boundary does not prove final presentation dependencies.
outcomesAndBounds.failed: Malformed, UnsafeReferenceOrProtection, UnsupportedShape, ClockContradiction, IdentityChanged, ResourceLimit, Io and Cancelled are closed terminal categories. Fail at the first offending absolute offset. Interior malformed bytes, valid-but-unsupported semantic content and an impossible declared length do not become recoverable tails merely because there are no later bytes. Preserve earlier draft facts for diagnostics only; no finalization authority follows from a failed outcome.
